children: On August 31, 2026, the company received notice from NYSE American that it is not in compliance with Section 1003(a)(i) because stockholders’ equity was $1.8 million, below the $2.0 million minimum, and it reported losses in recent years. The exchange had previously notified the company of noncompliance with Sections 1003(a)(ii) and 1003(a)(iii); a plan has been accepted with a compliance period through October 2, 2027. Shares will continue trading on NYSE American under MTNB with the .BC indicator during the plan period.
